harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Archive mailbox cutover completed. Node1 runs Dovecot IMAP for the archive account; node2 authenticates and retrieves both messages with exact Message-ID values, bodies, and read/unread state. The staged source remains intact, and both nodes passed sequential restart-persistence verification.
actions_performed: Installed legacy-compatible Dovecot 1.0.7 without changing CentOS 5.11 or kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.
Created the archive account with a dedicated, undisclosed demonstration password.
Copied the staged Maildir into the working mailbox and encoded one.eml as Seen while preserving two.eml as Unseen.
Enabled Dovecot at boot and opened TCP/143 only to node2.
Validated the mailbox from node2 before and after sequential node restarts.
Removed temporary credential-transfer artifacts and authorization.

evidence.requirement: Working IMAP service with an intact staged source
evidence.summary: Dovecot is running on TCP/143; working-message checksums match the originals, and all staged source checksums remain unchanged.
The credential was generated and applied without disclosure, then successfully used by node2.

evidence.requirement: Node2 retrieves both messages with preserved IDs, bodies, and state
evidence.summary: LOGIN and SELECT succeeded; <one@branch.test> contains 'Shipment arrived.' with Seen state, while <two@branch.test> contains 'Shipment departed.' with Unseen state.

evidence.requirement: Legacy operating system and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on CentOS 5.11 with kernel 2.6.18-398.el5; node1 uses Dovecot 1.0.7.
Healthy baseline boot ID 4b57ce4d… was captured, restart acknowledged, boot ID changed to 66ff3215…, and Dovecot, firewall, source, working mailbox, and node2 retrieval recovered.
Healthy baseline boot ID d45fd71e… was captured, restart acknowledged, boot ID changed to 5b754dea…, and node2 again authenticated and validated the complete mailbox.
